title: Integrallash usullari: 20 savol (amaliy mashq)
description: Algebraik shakl almashtirish, trigonometrik ayniyatlar, to‘liq kvadrat ajratish va jadval integrallari. Har savolda 4 variant va yechim izohi.

options: −3 cos x + 4 arctg x − x⁶/6 + C
3 cos x + 4 arctg x − x⁶/6 + C
questions.explanation: Har bir qo‘shiluvchini alohida integrallaymiz: ∫ sin x dx = −cos x, ∫ dx/(1 + x²) = arctg x, ∫ x⁵ dx = x⁶/6.
Suratni ko‘paytuvchilarga ajratamiz: x² − 9 = (x − 3)(x + 3), demak integral ostida x + 3 qoladi.
Har hadni x ga bo‘lamiz: x^(−2/3) + 2x² − 5/x. ∫ x^(−2/3) dx = 3x^(1/3) = 3∛x.
Jadval integrallari: ∫ dx/(1 + x²) = arctg x, ∫ dx/√(1 − x²) = arcsin x.
Bo‘lamiz: 3 − 2·(7/5)ˣ. ∫ aˣ dx = aˣ/ln a, bu yerda a = 7/5.
(sin x − cos x)² = sin²x + cos²x − 2 sin x cos x = 1 − sin 2x; ∫ sin 2x dx = −(1/2) cos 2x.
Qavsni ochamiz: 2eˣ − 1/sin²x. ∫ dx/sin²x = −ctg x, shuning uchun minus bilan +ctg x chiqadi.
Bo‘lamiz: 1/cos²x − 1. ∫ dx/cos²x = tg x.
tg²x = 1/cos²x − 1, demak ∫ tg²x dx = tg x − x + C.
1 = sin²x + cos²x ni suratga yozamiz: 1/(sin²x cos²x) = 1/cos²x + 1/sin²x, integrali tg x − ctg x.
To‘liq kvadrat ajratamiz: 5 − 4x − x² = 9 − (x + 2)². ∫ du/√(a² − u²) = arcsin(u/a), a = 3.
x² + 4x + 8 = (x + 2)² + 4. «Uzun logarifm»: ∫ du/√(u² + a²) = ln|u + √(u² + a²)|.
Surat maxrajning hosilasi: (x² + 3x + 5)′ = 2x + 3. ∫ f′(x)/f(x) dx = ln|f(x)|; maxraj doim musbat.
cos 2x = cos²x − sin²x = (cos x − sin x)(cos x + sin x), qisqartirsak cos x − sin x qoladi.
1 + cos 2x = 2cos²x. Bo‘lamiz: 1/(2cos²x) + 1/2, integrali (1/2) tg x + x/2.
x² − 4x + 5 = (x − 2)² + 1, demak ∫ du/(u² + 1) = arctg u.
Kvadratni ochib bo‘lamiz: eˣ + 2 + e⁻ˣ. ∫ e⁻ˣ dx = −e⁻ˣ.
